models:
Muse Ember

Muse Ember is the efficient execution model in the Muse family, built for high-volume, repeated work: sub-agent tasks, tool calls, routing, and processing large collections of images, files, and records. It takes the same requests as Muse Spark at a lower price per token. Pair it with Muse Spark or Muse Wonder: the larger model plans, and Muse Ember handles the volume.

Model IDInputOutput
muse-ember-1.0Text, image, video, audio, PDFText

On Model API, Muse Ember runs in Standard mode only. See the Muse Ember page for specs, recommended uses, and availability.
pricing:
Muse Ember

Model: muse-ember-1.0, in Standard mode only.

Muse Ember has two price tiers, and the input tokens in your API request set the tier, cached tokens included. When a request continues a stored conversation with previous_response_id, its input includes that conversation. A request with up to 200K input tokens is billed at the rates in the first column. A request with more is billed at the long-context rates in full, not only for the tokens past 200K. Your invoice and usage dashboard list the two tiers separately.
